verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as letting users "ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language" (docs-9) and the platform is described as moving "beyond assistance to automated remediation" (docs-38), implying agentic investigation capability, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI-driven root-cause analysis workflow tied to alerts/errors, nor any hands-on or independent confirmation it correctly identifies root causes. missing for 10: explicit docs on AI investigating a specific alert/error and outputting a root-cause hypothesis, and independent/community validation of this specific capability.
